title: Storyblok Story
description: A content entry (story) in Storyblok. Stories hold structured content defined by a component schema and include metadata such as publication timestamps, slugs, and language alternates.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier of the story within the space.

uuid.description: Universally unique identifier for cross-space references and relation resolution.

name.description: Display name of the story as shown in the Storyblok editor.

slug.description: URL-safe slug segment of the story within its parent folder.

full_slug.description: Full path of the story including parent folder slugs, used as the primary URL identifier.

content.description: The story content as a nested JSON object. Structure is determined by the assigned component schema. Always includes a component field identifying the root component type.

component.description: Technical name of the component schema used for this story content.

_uid.description: Unique identifier for the root content block.

is_startpage.description: True if this story is the start page (index entry) of its parent folder.

is_folder.description: True if this story is a folder rather than a content entry.

parent_id.description: Numeric ID of the parent folder story, or null if the story is at the root level.

group_id.description: UUID used to group alternate language versions of the same story together.

published.description: True if the story currently has an active published version visible via the public API token.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the story was most recently published. Null if never published.

first_published_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the story was first ever published. Null if never published.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the story was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent modification to the story.

sort_by_date.description: Optional date string used for custom date-based sorting of stories in lists.

tag_list.description: List of tag slugs applied to this story for categorization and filtering.

position.description: Numeric sort position of the story within its parent folder.

pinned.description: True if the story is pinned in the editor interface for quick access.

default_full_slug.description: The default language full_slug when the story has alternate language translations.

translated_slugs.description: Language-specific slug overrides for alternate language versions of this story.

alternates.description: Metadata references to alternate language versions of this story.

meta_data.description: Arbitrary custom metadata key-value pairs attached to the story.

path.description: Custom URL path override for the story, used instead of the full_slug.

TranslatedSlug.description: A language-specific slug override for an alternate language version of a story.

lang.description: ISO language code for this translated slug, such as de or fr.

path.description: The translated slug path for this language version.

name.description: Optional translated display name for this language version.

StoryAlternate.description: Brief metadata about an alternate language version of a story.

id.description: Numeric ID of the alternate story.

name.description: Display name of the alternate story.

slug.description: Slug segment of the alternate story.

full_slug.description: Full path of the alternate story.

is_folder.description: True if the alternate is a folder.

parent_id.description: Parent folder ID of the alternate story.

ContentBlock.description: A nestable content block within a story's content tree. Each block is identified by a component type and a unique block ID.

component.description: Technical name of the component schema defining this block's fields.

_uid.description: Unique identifier for this content block instance.
